anatomy.note: Clear bipedal demon silhouette with readable horns, wings, tail, and weapon.

finish.note: Cohesive dark-metal and ember treatment with strong focal contrast.

neutralAffinity.note: The creature is materially embodied; fire is confined to the weapon, armor seams, and environmental accents rather than forming the body.

visibleCounterplayCue.note: The oversized glowing greatsword and planted frontal stance telegraph a heavy, directional melee threat with implied slow commitment.

reviews.conciseRationale: Immediately reads as a top-tier demonic melee threat; fire supports the physical creature rather than replacing it.

anatomy.note: Central humanoid body and primary wing structure remain legible despite ornate halos.

framing.note: Strong centered hierarchy and clean vertical presentation.

finish.note: Polished ivory-gold rendering with controlled luminosity.

neutralAffinity.note: Radiance dominates the lighting but does not replace the clearly physical humanoid, garments, wings, and ornament.

visibleCounterplayCue.note: The open-handed casting pose suggests magic, but no specific attack direction, recovery state, or vulnerable feature is clearly exposed.

reviews.conciseRationale: Clear celestial authority, readable humanoid anchor, and convincing high-tier support identity, though its counterplay telegraph could be more explicit.

anatomy.note: Horns, bovine head, heavy torso, legs, weapon, and shield read cleanly.

framing.note: Close heroic crop emphasizes mass without losing the body.

finish.note: Grounded material rendering and strong silhouette separation.

neutralAffinity.note: Entirely physical hide, armor, stone, and weapon construction with no dominant elemental effect.

visibleCounterplayCue.note: The enormous directional shield and raised blunt weapon clearly imply frontal defense, slow attacks, and vulnerable flanks.

reviews.conciseRationale: A highly legible physical tank with strong positional counterplay and no distracting construction effect.

framing.note: Four secondary figures compete with the intended unit and make the token read as an encounter group.

finish.note: Coherent storm palette and detailed feather treatment.

neutralAffinity.note: The storm is environmental; the sovereign and attendants remain visibly feathered, armored physical creatures.

visibleCounterplayCue.note: The command tableau implies summons or coordination, but it shows neither a distinct attack telegraph nor an obvious vulnerable or recovery state.

reviews.conciseRationale: The sovereign is visually strong, but the entourage dilutes single-unit identity and does not establish actionable counterplay.

anatomy.note: Cobra hood, four arms, torso, and coiled tail are clearly organized.

framing.note: Centered full-body composition with balanced spell props.

finish.note: Refined teal-bronze materials and restrained magical accents.

neutralAffinity.note: Floating glyphs are discrete magical tools around a clearly physical cobra-humanoid body.

visibleCounterplayCue.note: Raised glyphs and the horizontally held ritual focus clearly signal channeling, while the grounded coils imply limited mobility during the cast.

reviews.conciseRationale: Distinct naga caster silhouette with strong role signaling, a physical body, and readable channeling cues.

anatomy.note: Lower coils merge with the dais and the ornate arm-and-apparatus cluster is difficult to parse.

finish.note: Rich jewel-metal finish with consistent ceremonial detail.

neutralAffinity.note: The magical rings and suspended objects remain accessories to a materially rendered serpentine figure.

visibleCounterplayCue.note: Raised implements suggest interruptible ritual channeling, and the massive fixed coils communicate low mobility.

reviews.conciseRationale: The regal identity and ritual behavior are convincing, but anatomy and apparatus blend into one over-dense structure.

anatomy.note: The central body is lost inside overlapping wings, rings, and luminous fragments.

framing.note: Broad wing mass fills the panel without a stable creature focal point.

finish.note: Near-white energy and filigree flatten depth and obscure material form.

neutralAffinity.note: Radiant energy, halos, and luminous wing-like structures dominate so completely that the creature appears constructed from unexplained light.

visibleCounterplayCue.note: The dense radial spectacle obscures attack direction, vulnerable anatomy, and any readable charge or recovery state.

reviews.conciseRationale: Reads primarily as radiant construction rather than a clearly embodied creature and provides no actionable combat telegraph.

anatomy.note: Massive bovine humanoid structure and weapon grip are clear.

framing.note: Centered full-body view strongly communicates scale and weight.

finish.note: Cohesive armor, hide, and cloth rendering with excellent value separation.

neutralAffinity.note: Fully physical hide, armor, cloth, and weapon presentation with no elemental construction.

visibleCounterplayCue.note: The huge axe, forward weight, and cumbersome build signal slow committed swings and exploitable recovery.

reviews.conciseRationale: Exceptionally clear physical warlord identity with immediate frontline role and heavy-attack counterplay readability.

anatomy.note: Torso, arms, legs, and trailing feathers overlap into an uncertain body structure.

framing.note: Isolated airborne subject is centered and fully contained.

finish.note: Dark values become muddy against the storm background, while cyan and violet accents feel disconnected.

neutralAffinity.note: Cyan and violet appear to be feather highlights; the creature remains physical rather than elementally constructed.

visibleCounterplayCue.note: The airborne posture indicates mobility, but obscured limbs and weapon details leave attack direction and recovery behavior unclear.

reviews.conciseRationale: The aerial role reads, but body construction, low contrast, and weak attack telegraph keep the creature from resolving cleanly.

anatomy.note: Horned winged demon form is recognizable despite the dark rendering.

framing.note: The stepped rune platform occupies too much of the image and reduces the creature's presence.

finish.note: Crushed shadows hide body and armor detail; ember lines overpower quieter forms.

neutralAffinity.note: Embers and runes accent a physical demon and platform without becoming the creature's primary construction.

visibleCounterplayCue.note: The static throne-like pose communicates authority but shows no clear weapon action, exposed weakness, charge, or recovery window.

reviews.conciseRationale: Strong demon identity, but the oversized base, underexposed figure, and absent combat telegraph weaken usable unit readability.
